# openwebui_audio_config (Resource)

Manages Open WebUI's audio engines: text to speech across OpenAI, Azure Speech, and Mistral, and speech to text across local faster-whisper, OpenAI, Deepgram, Azure, and Mistral.

`POST /api/v1/audio/config/update` requires both blocks and writes every key of each, so this resource reads the current configuration and overlays the attributes the plan names before it writes.

Setting `stt.engine` to the empty string makes Open WebUI load faster-whisper into its own process, downloading the model named by `stt.whisper_model` when it is not already cached. That apply can take minutes on its first run.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Open WebUI requires both blocks together. Setting stt.engine to the empty
# string loads faster-whisper into the Open WebUI process and downloads the
# model named by stt.whisper_model when it is not already cached.
resource "openwebui_audio_config" "example" {
  tts = {
    engine         = "openai"
    model          = "tts-1"
    voice          = "alloy"
    openai_api_key = var.openai_api_key
  }

  stt = {
    engine         = "openai"
    model          = "whisper-1"
    openai_api_key = var.openai_api_key
  }
}

variable "openai_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `stt` (Attributes) Speech to text settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stt))
- `tts` (Attributes) Text to speech settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this singleton resource. Always `audio`.

<a id="nestedatt--stt"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stt`

Optional:

- `allowed_extensions` (List of String) File extensions accepted for transcription. Stored as `audio.stt.allowed_extensions`.
- `azure_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Open WebUI setting `AZURE_API_KEY`. Stored as `audio.stt.azure.api_key`. Sensitive.
- `azure_base_url` (String) Open WebUI setting `AZURE_BASE_URL`. Stored as `audio.stt.azure.base_url`.
- `azure_locales` (String) Open WebUI setting `AZURE_LOCALES`. Stored as `audio.stt.azure.locales`.
- `azure_max_speakers` (String) Open WebUI setting `AZURE_MAX_SPEAKERS`. Stored as `audio.stt.azure.max_speakers`.
- `azure_region` (String) Open WebUI setting `AZURE_REGION`. Stored as `audio.stt.azure.region`.
- `deepgram_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Open WebUI setting `DEEPGRAM_API_KEY`. Stored as `audio.stt.deepgram.api_key`. Sensitive.
- `engine` (String) Speech to text engine. The empty string runs faster-whisper in the Open WebUI process. Stored as `audio.stt.engine`.
- `mistral_api_base_url` (String) Open WebUI setting `MISTRAL_API_BASE_URL`. Stored as `audio.stt.mistral.api_base_url`.
- `mistral_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Open WebUI setting `MISTRAL_API_KEY`. Stored as `audio.stt.mistral.api_key`. Sensitive.
- `mistral_use_chat_completions` (Boolean) Open WebUI setting `MISTRAL_USE_CHAT_COMPLETIONS`. Stored as `audio.stt.mistral.use_chat_completions`.
- `model` (String) Open WebUI setting `MODEL`. Stored as `audio.stt.model`.
- `openai_api_base_url` (String) Open WebUI setting `OPENAI_API_BASE_URL`. Stored as `audio.stt.openai.api_base_url`.
- `openai_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Open WebUI setting `OPENAI_API_KEY`. Stored as `audio.stt.openai.api_key`. Sensitive.
- `openai_api_request_format` (String) Request encoding for the OpenAI transcription API, for example `multipart`. Stored as `audio.stt.openai.api_request_format`.
- `supported_content_types` (List of String) Content types accepted for transcription. Stored as `audio.stt.supported_content_types`.
- `whisper_model` (String) faster-whisper model loaded when `engine` is the empty string. Stored as `audio.stt.whisper_model`.


<a id="nestedatt--tts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tts`

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Key for the generic text to speech engine, used by ElevenLabs and others. Stored as `audio.tts.api_key`. Sensitive.
- `azure_speech_base_url` (String) Open WebUI setting `AZURE_SPEECH_BASE_URL`. Stored as `audio.tts.azure.speech_base_url`.
- `azure_speech_output_format` (String) Open WebUI setting `AZURE_SPEECH_OUTPUT_FORMAT`. Stored as `audio.tts.azure.speech_output_format`.
- `azure_speech_region` (String) Open WebUI setting `AZURE_SPEECH_REGION`. Stored as `audio.tts.azure.speech_region`.
- `engine` (String) Text to speech engine. The empty string is Open WebUI's built-in engine. Stored as `audio.tts.engine`.
- `mistral_api_base_url` (String) Open WebUI setting `MISTRAL_API_BASE_URL`. Stored as `audio.tts.mistral.api_base_url`.
- `mistral_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Open WebUI setting `MISTRAL_API_KEY`. Stored as `audio.tts.mistral.api_key`. Sensitive.
- `model` (String) Open WebUI setting `MODEL`. Stored as `audio.tts.model`.
- `openai_api_base_url` (String) Open WebUI setting `OPENAI_API_BASE_URL`. Stored as `audio.tts.openai.api_base_url`.
- `openai_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Open WebUI setting `OPENAI_API_KEY`. Stored as `audio.tts.openai.api_key`. Sensitive.
- `openai_params` (String) JSON object of extra parameters passed to the OpenAI speech API. Stored as `audio.tts.openai.params`.
- `split_on` (String) Boundary the text is split on before synthesis, for example `punctuation`. Stored as `audio.tts.split_on`.
- `voice` (String) Open WebUI setting `VOICE`. Stored as `audio.tts.voice`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Open WebUI holds one audio configuration, so this resource is a singleton.
# Import it under its fixed id.
terraform import openwebui_audio_config.example audio
```
